lines.zh: 我一摆尾，海水慢慢让开。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and the sea gives way.
I swim slowly, but I am huge.
My back is covered in pale spots.
I pass slowly beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片浅滩。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole shallow flat.
Warm water makes my swimming easy.
With my mouth open, I filter as I go.
Small fish part to let me through.
My fins cut through the warm current.
I circle the reef slowly.
My tail stirs up a cloud of sand.
I rise to the surface and sun my back.
Turning this big body takes a while.
I follow the warm current north.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，把身后的浑水留下。
lines.en: I swing my tail slowly, leaving cloudy water behind.

lines.zh: 我从礁石的阴影里游到光下。
lines.en: I glide from the reef's shade into the light.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一路吞着暖水。
lines.en: Mouth open, I swallow warm water as I go.

lines.zh: 我掠过头顶，背上的斑点晃过。
lines.en: I pass overhead, and my spots slide across the light.
I hover with my mouth still open.

lines.zh: 浮游生物一点点进我嘴里。
lines.en: Plankton trickles into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，看得不远。
lines.en: My eyes are small and see only so far.

lines.zh: 有两条小鱼在我身边蹭。
lines.en: Two small fish rub against my side.

lines.zh: 我不赶它们，也不吃它们。
lines.en: I do not shoo them, nor eat them.

lines.zh: 阳光在暖海面上碎成一片。
lines.en: Sunlight shatters across the warm sea.

lines.zh: 我那双小眼睛慢慢眨了一下。
lines.en: My small eyes blink once, slowly.
My gills open and close, heavy and slow.

lines.zh: 水里的细末够我吃一天。
lines.en: The specks in the water feed me all day.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像一块会动的礁石。
lines.en: I hang there like a moving reef.
There is a boat sound far away.

lines.zh: 我背上的点在光里发亮。
lines.en: The spots on my back shine in the light.
My fins sway gently.
This sea is warm; I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 你在我面前像一条小鱼。
lines.en: You look like a small fish before me.
I lower my gaze to you, slowly.

lines.zh: 你的船桨比我的鳍还小。
lines.en: Your paddle is smaller than one of my fins.
I will not eat you; you are not small enough.
The water only reaches your waist there.
I turn just to look at you.
Do not fear; my mouth only filters water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我斑点上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my spots.
I swim away slowly, not touching you.
Your clothes carry the smell of fish blood.
A cut opens in my thick hide.
My hide is thick enough to filter water.
I keep swimming slowly, unbothered.

lines.zh: 我的血在温水里散成淡雾。
lines.en: My blood spreads into pale mist in the warm water.
Something bit my fin.
I shake my whole body.
Even someone my size feels pain.

lines.zh: 我带着伤口往下沉一截。
lines.en: I sink a little deeper with the wound.
I do not strike back; I just swim off.
The wound burns in the warm water.

lines.zh: 你撒下的细末漂成一片。
lines.en: What you scatter drifts into a cloud.
This cloud of plankton is thick.
I open my mouth and turn toward it.
I do not chase; I let it come in.
Warm water holds the most food.
This smell brings me a little closer.
There is good food by your boat.
One mouthful filters a great deal.
Do not come too close; I may hit the boat.
I circle this cloud slowly.
Bumping me is like hitting a wall.
My hide is thick; you took the worst of it.
You knock me half a foot off course.
My fin sweeps your shoulder.
Careful; I turn very slowly.
Your hand presses on my back.
I stop and wait for you to move.
Being this big, I cannot dodge you.
We have stirred the sand up.
After the bump I cruise slowly away.
I follow the trail of your wake.
Two great shadows travel side by side.
Your spots are denser than mine.
This warm sea is enough for us both.
I slow down and wait for you.
We both open our mouths and filter.
Do not go far; I follow slowly.
My fin touches yours.

lines.zh: 有船来的时候，我们下沉。
lines.en: When boats come, we sink lower.

lines.zh: 我围着你慢慢绕了个大圈。
lines.en: I make a slow wide circle around you.
This thing is stuck by my teeth.
My mouth will not take anything this big.
I hold it, then spit it out.
It smells of dried fish.
I nudge it forward with my wide mouth.
It slips away from my mouth.
I do not need it; filtering is enough.
I take this fish steak.

lines.zh: 我把它含在宽嘴里慢慢咽。
lines.en: I hold it in my wide mouth and swallow.
Do not drop it on my head.
A big cloud of specks lies ahead.
That school of small fish bunches up.
I open my mouth at the food cloud.
This patch of water is the thickest.
I adjust my heading slowly.
The target is large; I need not hurry.
I swim toward the brighter water.
Something is moving there.
My mouth is already ready.
This whole stretch is food.
I do not chase; I follow the water.
The current carries the cloud left.

lines.zh: 我把大脑袋慢慢偏过去。
lines.en: I swing my great head slowly around.
The small fish scatter before me.
My great mouth stays open.
I am still some way from the cloud.
I lower my body near the surface.
Those specks cannot get away.
I keep moving forward without stopping.
Almost there; I close my eyes.
My tail sweeps the water into a wall.
My body slams across, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 我张嘴一吸，水全涌进来。
lines.en: I gape and the water rushes in.
This is not a bite; it is a ram.
My fin sweeps it aside.
I barely touch it and it retreats.
I do not like fighting.
My hide is rough; it scrapes.
When it ends I go back to filtering.
You should swim farther away.

lines.zh: 我在温暖的海面下出现。
lines.en: I appear beneath the warm surface.
I am the only one in this stretch.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水照在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the water onto my back.
First I circle once to learn the way.
The warm water settles me.

lines.zh: 我的斑点在水里很显眼。
lines.en: My spots stand out in the water.
I open my mouth from the very start.
There is plenty of food here; good.
I head slowly for deeper water.
There is only one big shadow: mine.
Fire burns on the surface and scalds my back.

lines.zh: 我摔在浅滩上，沙都陷了。
lines.en: I crash onto the flats and the sand gives way.
I am stranded in the shallows, unable to move.
The blast leaves my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我背上的厚皮。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my thick hide.
Strange force crawls along my spots.

lines.zh: 水里空了，我滤不到东西。
lines.en: The water is empty; I filter nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我整条发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and numbs all of me.

lines.zh: 我从水里落下去，没有底。
lines.en: I drop out of the water into nothing.
